decisions.statement: A story is followed by the royal road id the story states.
That id is read off the story's record of royal road.
A story stating no such record is not followed.
A chapter filed here states its id and link as one record of royal road.
No story page is created here.
A chapter already held is known by its royal road id rather than by its title.
A chapter stating no royal road id is known by the id its link has.
A chapter already filed is read whether that chapter names its story by page type or by slug alone.
A chapter royal road hides or keeps locked is left where that chapter is.
A chapter's name opens with its story's slug.
The story's slug is followed by the chapter's position padded to four digits.
The title follows the position.
A title is cut back to whole words at fifty characters.
A name is cut back further where that name would otherwise run past a slug's hundred characters.
A name another chapter already has takes the chapter's royal road id on the end.
A chapter's name is unique across every chapter rather than within its story.
A chapter names the story that chapter is part of by page type and slug rather than by slug alone.
A chapter names the unit its length is counted in the same way.
A story's status is restated only where royal road says ongoing or completed or hiatus.
A story naming no world is left unrestated and said to be.
A second and a half sits between one request to royal road and the next.
The pages composed are shown rather than landed unless the run was asked to commit those pages.
Pages land fifty at a time.
Each fifty is its own commit.
A page lands with the files beside that page.
A file lands through a change named by address rather than through an edit composed here.
A page goes up through the change that works out the kind of the path handed in.
A page's id is worked out by that change rather than by the landing.
A restated story whose page already has that body states no edit rather than refusing the batch.
A chapter refused for holding no prose is named by the page read and the refusal that chapter hit.
A run that failed a chapter is a failed run however much else that run composed.

definition: every chapter royal road lists for a story read and filed under that story
